# exo_clutter (Data Source)

Look up an existing Clutter object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `enable` (String) Maps to the -Enable parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `use_custom_routing` (Boolean) Maps to the -UseCustomRouting parameter.
